plate.adhesion: User-confirmed glue; 5 mm outer brim; no raft

retained_exceptions.applied: PETG support base; PLA interface; three dense interface layers; zero top and bottom Z gaps; no raft. Keep prime tower and no contaminated flushing into model or supports.
retained_exceptions.qualification: Outside the guide: it explicitly excludes PETG Translucent and only covers PLA Basic with PETG HF/Basic. Engineering Plate is not one of its listed plates.
retained_exceptions.material_exception: Retain the user-selected PETG Translucent / PLA Translucent recipes (PETG 250/245 C, PLA 220 C) and Engineering Plate with glue at 70 C; do not claim the guide's 60 C / PLA Basic 230 C process is validated for these filaments.
retained_exceptions.geometry_exception: Keep qualified snug supports, bed-only scope, 0.7 mm XY clearance and fixed 0.16 mm support layers instead of copying the guide's 0.4 mm tree-support template; these protect insert/cable bores and cap ceiling coverage.
retained_exceptions.cooling_exception: Keep native translucent P2S cooling; the downloaded guide P2S recipe is for PLA Basic/PETG HF and must not overwrite the full translucent recipes.
retained_exceptions.operator: Dry each material using its own supplier instructions; ventilate the P2S by opening the door and/or top cover while PLA is in use.

cap_geometry.unsupported_bridging: not physically qualified; production caps retain supports

comparison_to_official_P2S_template.nozzle: Official 0.4 mm; project 0.6 mm HF. No foreign printer/start G-code imported.
comparison_to_official_P2S_template.support_shape: Official tree/default; project normal/snug with protected bores and existing ceiling audit.

user_print_setup: Dry each material by its own supplier procedure. Open P2S door and/or top cover while printing with PLA.
